subject: MarketGate renewal — request for benchmark, capacity uplift & commercial counter
messages:
From: Alex Wu <alex.wu@marketgate.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-02-10T09:12:00Z
Subject: Renewal benchmarking + capacity ask (MarketGate renewal)

Hi Camila,

We’re approaching our contract renewal window with Redwood (May 2028) and procurement has asked us to run a short benchmark and get commercial terms aligned. RivalAI just came in with a pretty aggressive offer and our platform team wants to validate throughput and tail latency before we commit to a longer term.

High-level ask: can Redwood run a 48-hour benchmark against our 75M monthly token profile (mixed chat + instruction) and provide:
- steady-state tokens/sec and 99th pct latency for a 4k context workload
- run artifacts/logs and a short report we can share with engineering
- a commercial uplist: options for a 15–30% capacity uplift (dedicated pool) and committed pricing for 12 months

We’re open to doing this as a joint test harness. Can you confirm scope and timelines? Procurement copied.

Thanks,
Alex
Alex Wu
Senior PM, MarketGate
alex.wu@marketgate.com
(attachment: marketgate_benchmark_spec.md)

From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Wu <alex.wu@marketgate.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-02-11T10:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Renewal benchmarking + capacity ask (MarketGate renewal)

Alex — thanks for the clear ask. We can run the 48-hour benchmark and provide the artifacts you requested. Quick notes and proposed plan:

1) Scope: 75M tokens/month profile, 4k context mixed chat workload — we’ll use your spec (attached) and our standard harness.
2) Deliverables: raw token throughput, p50/p95/p99 latency, KV-cache warm vs cold, and a one-page summary with recommended dedicated-pool sizing.
3) Timeline: kickoff this Friday 2028-02-13 (we need a signed test NDA), run 48 hours, report by Monday 2028-02-16.
4) Commercial: we can propose a 12-month dedicated pool offer with staged discounts tied to committed tokens. I’ll loop in Ben and Priyom for pricing & capacity.

If that timeline works I’ll send a short SOW + test NDA and schedule the run.

Best,
Camila Reyes
Account Executive — Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.ai
(attachment: redwood_execution_notes.txt)

From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-02-12T08:45:00Z
Subject: Internal: MarketGate renewal — pricing scenarios & save play

Team — Alex at MarketGate has asked for a 48-hour benchmark. RivalAI is already in with a lower headline price; procurement is leaning on proof-of-performance and a commercial counter. I recommend the following playbook:

- Offer A (Retention-first): 12 month dedicated pool, 20% uplift in capacity, 10% renewal credit (applied to month 1), latency SLO (p99 < 350ms at their modeled qps), 2-week onboarding support included. Margin: medium.
- Offer B (Aggressive save): 12 month commit + 3 month accelerated onboarding, 15% list discount, 25% committed capacity uplift, but require EOM sign and 30% annual minimum. Margin: lower.
- Proof path: run the 48-hour benchmark with our harness, produce bench artifacts (redwood_bench_baseline.csv) and an ops runbook. Provide a short side-by-side with RivalAI where we highlight tail-latency and KV-cache warming benefits.

Attachments: internal_pricing_scenarios.xlsx (pricing math), suggested bench script.

Ask: Ben — can you validate the latency SLO and whether we can offer the 2-week onboarding for Offer A without escalating to Solutions? Marissa — can you prep a draft statement of work + DocuSign template if we go Offer A? Priyom — ops, confirm we can schedule the run Friday and the resource allocation on our dedicated pool.

Camila

From: Alex Wu <alex.wu@marketgate.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@marketgate.com
Date: 2028-02-14T16:20:00Z
Subject: Re: Renewal benchmarking + capacity ask (MarketGate renewal)

Camila — quick update from our side. RivalAI shared a technical brief and offered a 25% lower committed rate and claims 15% better tokens/sec for 4k contexts in their reference tests. Procurement is pressing us to prefer the lower-cost vendor unless we can provide a short proof-of-performance that clearly demonstrates value.

Time is a bit tight — we need bench artifacts and a commercial counter within 48 hours to stay in the running. Is Redwood able to accelerate the baseline run and deliver by 2028-02-16 EOD? Also, if you have a targeted retention offer that includes a capacity uplift and a short trial runway, please share it in your counter.

—Alex

From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Wu <alex.wu@marketgate.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-02-16T09:30:00Z
Subject: MarketGate — proof plan + commercial counterproposal

Alex — appreciate the clarity. We accelerated and here’s our counterproposal (summary):

1) Proof-of-performance run:
   - 48-hour run completed (results attached). Artifacts: redwood_bench_baseline.csv (throughput + latency traces), run logs, and a 2-page ops summary.
   - Results (summary): steady-state tokens/sec within 5% of RivalAI claim; p99 tail latency materially better when KV cache is warmed (see attached csv).

2) Commercial counter (valid until 2028-02-24):
   - Offer A (Balanced): 12-month dedicated pool, +20% capacity uplift, 10% renewal credit on month 1 invoice, guaranteed p99 < 350ms for up to profiled qps, onboarding window: 2 weeks.
   - Offer B (Economic): 12-month commit + 3-month onboarding acceleration, 18% list discount, require signed commitment and 30% annual minimum.

3) Operational commitments: priority scheduling for onboarding (Mar 1 target if signed by Feb 24), monthly health report, and a 2-week dedicated SE engagement during migration.

Attachments: marketgate_proof_plan.pdf (bench summary + recommended sizing), link to DocuSign (https://www.docusign.com/---/marketgate-renewal-offer).

If you prefer, we can lock Offer A now and provide a one-week extension to evaluate the run artifacts. Let me know what tradeoffs procurement needs to see (price vs guaranteed performance).

Best,
Camila
(attachment: marketgate_proof_plan.pdf)

From: Alex Wu <alex.wu@marketgate.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@marketgate.com
Date: 2028-02-17T11:05:00Z
Subject: Re: MarketGate — proof plan + commercial counterproposal

Camila — thanks for the fast turnaround and the artifacts. The engineering team will review but procurement pushed back hard on price. Two quick asks from procurement:

1) Can Redwood shave another 3% off Offer A (effective on the first 6 months)?
2) If we sign by Feb 24, can you guarantee the Mar 1 onboarding date and provide a named SE for the first two weeks?

If you can confirm both, procurement will prioritize Redwood and we’ll route the PO.

—Alex
